description: The hub declares Accommodation Supplement entitlement scenarios S0, S1, S2, S3 and S5 after calibration, and calibration variants V1 to V4 from the raw nz.open branch. Each non-central scenario changes one central knob. Bands report the minimum, S0 and maximum gap across the declared scenarios and identify each bound-setting scenario.
status: The hub adopts the declared scenario set under H7; C1 rent ageing and D2 publication approval remain open.

knob_domains.rent_stock_factor: a positive number; the central value 1 holds Census rent levels fixed while the hub resolves C1 rent ageing

scenarios.description: central defaults: the central value of every MC3 band
asset test off: the Accommodation Supplement cash-assets input is set to 0 (upper bound)
household rent split per adult share instead of allocated to the reference unit (upper sensitivity)
the alternative territorial authority to Accommodation Supplement area crosswalk (as_area_crosswalk.json alternative)

reg 17 superannuitant treatment, the alternative to the MC11 default. The override is the engine-calling bridge, which rewrites the base rate; a non-engine override would hand-compute policy (as_rate_bridge.json superannuitant_units)
low aging index for the calibration references (MC5 ages IRD bands from TY2024 to TY2026-27 by a declared index)

V3 starts from the raw nz.open branch and uses the resolved beneficiary_assignment variant profile in receipt_contract.json to draw a separate deterministic receipt stream for NZ Super, SLP, SPS and JS with the same targets and eligibility definitions.
d1886: allocate each region's Census size residual only to one- and two-person households in their stated proportions; tenure remains proportionally allocated

annualisation.note: the conformance harness uses 365/7 weeks (WEEKS_IN_MODEL_YEAR in TheAxiomFoundation/ops nz-lane/emtr_reproduction/run.py at ba6e7d6e); the model states and uses 52

keying_note: Charter C2 (adding a scenario re-keys only the bands and package nodes) holds only if each scenario's graph nodes carry that scenario's own resolved knobs and a digest of its own entry, not this file's SHA-256. The hub removes the MBIE bond-stock sensitivity under H7 because central rent uses Census bands. The hub still must resolve C1 ageing from Census 2023 rent levels to 2026-27; the central rent_stock_factor of 1 declares no ageing and does not settle C1.
